details:
I've been a loyal VRChat player since 2018 and genuinely enjoy supporting the staff through VRC+. However, I believe there are a few concerns that should be addressed for those who either cannot afford VRC+ or simply choose not to subscribe.

Certain VRC+ features, such as stickers, parallax menu backdrops, photo invites, and especially age verification (which should not be locked behind VRC+ at all), have been around for a while and should now be made available to free-to-play users. Restricting these long-standing features feels unnecessary, and making them more accessible would improve the overall experience for the entire community.

That said, I’d also love to see some additional perks for VRC+ subscribers, such as:

- Customizable parallax menu backgrounds

- A way to display "Legendary User" status for the players who have it

- Increased limits for custom and  addition to that add group emojis

- The ability to import/export items from worlds

I truly appreciate the work being put into VRChat and hope these suggestions can help make the platform even better for both free and VRC+ users alike.
title: My thought on VRC+ and how it effects FTP players.
